patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a video background with foreground content (mattresses, text, CTAs) centered over it, creating a dynamic and immersive introduction.
Alternating dark and light background sections, often with full-width imagery or product grids, used to visually segment content and guide the user down the page.
A transforming sticky header: the initial transparent, taller navigation bar shrinks in height and gains a solid white background as the user scrolls down, remaining fixed at the top.
Subtle parallax scrolling in the hero section where the background video/image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing depth perception.
Scroll-triggered content reveals where sections and their internal elements (e.g., text blocks, image cards) fade in and subtly slide upwards as they enter the viewport.

Strategic use of a vibrant teal/green accent color for primary calls to action and key interactive elements, providing clear visual hierarchy against a largely neutral dark grey, white, and light grey palette.
A consistent pairing of a prominent, clean sans-serif for headings with a slightly lighter weight sans-serif for body text, maintaining a sophisticated yet approachable brand voice.
Dedicated 'trust' sections featuring customer reviews, brand values (sustainability, quality, origin), and awards, integrated throughout the page to build credibility.

technique_notes: The hero section integrates a full-width video background, which is then overlaid with a subtle dark gradient or tint to ensure optimal contrast and readability for the superimposed text and calls to action.

A sticky header is implemented using CSS, where the initial transparent and taller navigation bar dynamically transitions to a shorter, solid white background version once the user scrolls past the hero section, maintaining persistent access to navigation.

Scroll-triggered content reveals are used throughout the page. As sections enter the viewport, elements within them (e.g., images, text blocks, cards) animate into view with a combination of a fade-in and a subtle upward slide, likely orchestrated using CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif body text; subheadings are often slightly lighter weight.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (mostly sharp corners, but some buttons and input fields have a very slight radius of 2-4px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around sections, airy hero, but product grids are quite dense).

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated blend of high-quality product photography and a clean, modern aesthetic that elevates the perception of mattresses from a commodity to a luxury item, despite the 'affordable' messaging. The subtle motion design, particularly the hero parallax and scroll-triggered reveals, adds a premium, interactive feel without being distracting.
